title: feat: C_GenerateRandom via wolfCrypt RNG
description: C_GenerateRandom returns CKR_FUNCTION_NOT_SUPPORTED. wolfCrypt already has a WC_RNG available in the library. Several PKCS#11 clients call C_GenerateRandom as a sanity check before trusting the module, and fail hard when it returns NOT_SUPPORTED. This is a low-complexity, high-compatibility-payoff implementation: initialize a per-call WC_RNG (same pattern as flash_sign), fill the caller buffer, return CKR_OK.
